# Benchmarks

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

  family = "krm",
  pages = c(

```

KRM benchmark comparisons use canonical isolated targets from the package benchmark ladder and bundled fish compatibility checks.

| Canonical case | Max abs. $\Delta$ TS (dB) | Mean abs. $\Delta$ TS (dB) | Elapsed (s) |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| Gas sphere | 7.91469 | 6.04116 | 0.01 |
| Weakly scattering sphere | 11.21090 | 0.47451 | 0.15 |
| Gas prolate spheroid | 7.36054 | 4.62751 | 0.00 |
| Weakly scattering prolate spheroid | 14.27193 | 0.46239 | 0.00 |
| Gas cylinder | 7.35632 | 6.19094 | 0.02 |
| Weakly scattering cylinder | 23.22115 | 0.59807 | 0.02 |

## Body-plus-swimbladder reference frequencies

The sardine SBF case is benchmarked against the KRMr, echoSMs, and NOAA reference-frequency family using the documented low-contrast convention, seawater density `1030 kg m^-3`, and seawater sound speed `1490 m s^-1`.

| Frequency (kHz) | Reference TS (dB) | acousticTS TS (dB) | $\Delta TS$ (dB) |
|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 12 | -33.981600 | -33.981600 | 0.000000 |
| 24 | -35.980723 | -35.980723 | 0.000000 |
| 60 | -40.771343 | -40.771343 | 0.000000 |
| 100 | -46.021179 | -46.021179 | 0.000000 |
| 120 | -76.074901 | -76.074901 | 0.000000 |
| 200 | -39.128308 | -39.128308 | 0.000000 |
| 300 | -46.273771 | -46.273771 | 0.000000 |
| 400 | -42.816793 | -42.816793 | 0.000000 |

| Benchmark summary | N frequency | Mean abs. $\Delta TS$ (dB) | Max abs. $\Delta TS$ (dB) |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| acousticTS vs KRMr reference frequencies | 8 | 0.000000 | 0.000000 |
| acousticTS vs echoSMs reference frequencies | 8 | 0.000000 | 0.000000 |
| acousticTS vs NOAA reference frequencies | 8 | 0.002600 | 0.005000 |

::: {.tip data-title="Keep software checks in Benchmarks"}
These rows check implementation agreement at documented reference frequencies. Full SBF validation still requires component-wise or full-wave checks of the body, inclusion, placement, and coherent total.
:::
